fieldValues.claim: A definition never changes underneath the records that use it, and records still move through states.
fieldValues.title: Fixed meaning, changing state
fieldValues.explanation: Field semantics are immutable and a Record binds to an exact Type version, so what a value means is fixed. State is separate: with the lifecycle extension a Record moves through declared states, such as draft and ratified, without its meaning changing. When meaning must change, the answer is a new version or a successor, never an edit in place.
